basics.name: Fahridana Ahmad Rayyansyah
basics.summary: Software engineer with 1 year of experience building web and mobile applications in TypeScript, PHP, Go, and Dart.

points: Migrated the Performance Appraisal system from native PHP to Laravel 12 for 200+ employees; it runs on the company's internal network.
Replaced manual entry that took an estimated 2–3 days per evaluation period with HRIS database-view sync and bulk Excel import of scoring standards.
Built evaluation periods with deadlines and locking, admin and evaluator dashboards, and Excel/PDF report export.
Gathered requirements from HR and supervisors, and trained admin users on the new system.
Built UI features in Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
Built a video summarization feature: the app follows a YouTube channel by ID, reads new videos' auto-captions, and uses the OpenAI API to generate a summary and keywords.
Built components for the shared Radix UI library, with Storybook documentation and Jest tests.

projects.name: Cache Strategy Benchmarking — Moodle-Inspired LMS
points: Thesis project: a Moodle-inspired LMS in Laravel 12 that compares Cache-Aside, Read-Through, and Write-Through caching with Redis 7.
Ran k6 load tests with up to 2,000 concurrent users and compared P99 latency for each strategy.

projects.name: HRIS — Human Resource Information System
points: Built a multi-tenant HRIS with a Go backend and a Next.js frontend, including Midtrans subscription billing.
Built a geofencing attendance system with live maps (TanStack Query, Supabase Auth), packaged with Docker and deployed to Azure.

projects.name: Leafolyze — Leaf Tomato Disease Analyzer
points: Built a Flutter app with the BLoC pattern that detects tomato leaf disease on-device with TensorFlow Lite.
Added a marketplace and a REST API layer with Dio and the repository pattern.
